title: 第19章 金陵修士第20章 时人莫小池中水
content_zh:
苏州是全国高考竞争最激烈的地区，卷幼儿园，卷小学，卷初中，卷高中，十多年的寒窗苦读，江凡好不易考上华夏药科大学，到了大学依旧非常努力，上半学期考试成绩名列中药学专业前五。
可天不遂人愿，江凡遭遇人生重大变故，变卖家产还钱债务，由富家公子变成一贫如洗的‘孤儿’，即使燕京秦家家主秦经伦肯帮助江凡，江凡也不可能接受抛妻弃子的秦经伦任何援助。
至于江凡的胞妹秦紫菱，莫轻舞略有耳闻，秦家人对秦紫菱这个嫡系长女还算不错，也仅仅只是不错，秦紫菱也不见得有心思或实力帮助从未谋面的胞哥江凡。
中药学专业一年学费五千五百元，住宿费一年八百，纵使生活费再怎么节俭，一年的生活费少说也得两千块钱，一年八千多的支出对于普通家庭是个巨大开销，更何况孤家寡人的江凡。
遭遇人生重大变故，如今又是一贫如洗，也许还有其他原因，没有钱财继续完成大学学业，人生失去目标和意义，江凡也才自暴自弃，放弃自我，随波逐流。
莫轻舞掏出包里一叠百元大钞，钱虽不多，可以解江凡燃眉之急，寒暑假兼职赚钱，再加上奖学金、助学金和学费减免，也可以顺利完成学业，随即递向江凡，“这是我的压岁钱，一年六个点，毕业后三年内还清。”
江凡瞬间一阵无语，这不和李子茜同样的套路，担心他自尊心受打击，以高利贷的名义向他放贷，让他继续读大学，完成大学学业。
“怎么，嫌少？”
莫轻舞暗暗翻白眼，如今不同当初，不能再向之前花钱大手大脚，无奈继续说道：“期末好好考试，奖学金不太靠谱，助学金和学费全免没多大问题，悠着点花，，，”
“莫女神，谢过你的好意，我现在不怎么缺钱，上个月有人比你还黑，一年八个点借给我五万块钱。”
“李子茜？”
“你认识？”
“不熟”
，莫轻舞轻轻点头，李家小公主同秦紫菱关系要好，秦紫菱通过李子茜向江凡借钱也说的过去，随即吐槽道：“你已不差钱了，还每天不务正业，不好好学习。”
“知人者智，自知者明；胜人者有力，自胜者强；知足者富，强行者有志。”
江凡无语看向莫轻舞，哥正是务正业才把时间和精力用在修炼上，而不是浪费在课堂上，“莫女神，如今我的智商高达，看东西过目不忘，已不需要再浪费时间去上课。”
智商高达，过目不忘，莫轻舞故作呕吐状，装X遭雷劈，如此装X，你就不怕再次遭雷劈，猛然说道：“夫礼者，忠信之薄而乱之首。”
“道德经·第三十八章，前识者，道之华而愚之始。
是以大丈夫处其厚，不居其薄，处其实，不居其华，，，”
“真自当之，无有代者。”

“天量寿经·卷下，人在世间，爱欲之中，独生独死，独去独来，当行至趣苦乐之地，身自当之，无有代者。
善恶变化，殃福异处，，，”
真的过目不忘？莫轻舞诧异打量着江凡，佛经、道经对答如流，那专业知识肯定熟记于心，也不用再劝诫什么，一叠钞票递给江凡，一年六个点，毕业后三年内还清，郁闷扬长而去。
好吧，班花莫轻舞挺不错的，昨天得知他中途辍学，特意准备了一万块钱，借钱给他解燃眉之急，劝诫他完成大学学业，不要自暴自弃，迷途知返，洗心革面，重新做人！
收起一万块钱，回宿舍拿了户口本、护照、驾驶证、玉佩等东西，告知众人在外面租下房子，有事电话联系，随后骑着雅马哈摩托车一路风驰电掣向着半山腰的紫玄山庄狂飙。
紫玄山庄不愧是金陵最顶级别墅之一，严格的安保措施只是其微不足道一面，白天的鸟鸣虫吟声为山庄增添几分生动，而晚上的山庄是极致的静谧，犹如喧嚣都市中的世外桃源！
盘膝坐在别墅的天台，江凡瞬间沉浸在超然物外的状态中，奔腾不息的长江，郁郁葱葱的紫金山，微波粼粼的玄武湖，丝丝稀薄灵气宛如受到召唤般，向着半山腰的紫玄山庄蜂拥而去。
旭日东升，紫气东来。
丝丝紫气犹如天地精华进入江凡体内，没有迎来晨曦的第一缕晨光，一声嘹亮而悠长的‘狼吼’打破紫金山的宁静，令沉浸在修炼中的江凡猛然惊醒。
江凡微微睁眼，紫玄山庄的地段在金陵得天独厚，背靠紫金山，面朝玄武湖，同样也是欣赏日出的好地方，山顶便是最佳欣赏日出的观日台，而江凡在别墅天台，被那些欣赏日出的市民‘狼吼’声惊醒无可厚非。
无所谓，以后在别墅院内草坪上修炼，闭目继续修炼，没过多久，再次被一些仇富游客的歌声打扰，歌声嘹亮，好像生怕紫玄山庄的富豪睡得太安稳。
真是离了个大谱，收功起身，江凡向着别墅三楼的卧室走去，炼体的淬体液药材已准备好，可卫生间的浴室却空空如也，洗发露、沐浴露、洗面奶、牙膏、牙刷等洗漱用品倒是有，但毛巾、澡巾、搓澡巾等东西却没有，，，
不得不说有钱人真的很惜命，早上五点半，除了上夜班的工人和读高中的学生，绝大部分的市民沉浸在梦想之中，七点多还想睡个回笼觉，而居住在紫玄山庄的一些老人，早已在山庄内的小公园开始晨练，或是太极拳，或是八段锦，个个皆是有模有样。
哈哈，江凡禁不住一阵轻笑，要是江苏的百姓生活在修真世界，单凭那卷王的精神，恐怕会卷死修真界所有修士，横扫修真界，一统浩瀚宇宙！
江凡悠闲向着山下走去，嘴角泛起一丝苦笑，也许真的需要收一个童子，不，是找一个保姆，照顾他的生活起居，处理日常事务，不用浪费时间在这些琐事上。
缓步来到山脚下的竹心湖公园，映入眼帘的是翠绿欲滴的竹林，空气中弥漫着淡淡竹香，微风轻拂，竹叶沙沙作响，湖面微波荡漾，用力深呼吸，瞬间令人心旷神怡，疲惫一扫而空。
正当江凡沉浸在沁人心脾的竹香之中，前方的竹林里传来一老一少的谈话声，好像是一位老者在教导孙子功法，呵斥孙子嚣张跋扈、骄傲自大云云。
雷霆拳？江凡不由得一阵懵逼，数万年前雪域八品宗门雷河宗的镇门绝技，世间多有残篇，只有雷属性灵根修士可修炼，难道苍玄大陆的功法也流落到地球上，地球上也有修士？

content_en:
Suzhou is the most competitive area for the college entrance examination in the country. After more than ten years of hard study, Jiang Fan was admitted to Huaxia Pharmaceutical University. After taking the exams for kindergarten, primary school, junior high school and high school, Jiang Fan finally got into Huaxia Pharmaceutical University. When he got to university, he still worked very hard, and his test scores in the first half of the semester ranked among the top five majors in traditional Chinese medicine.
However, things did not go as planned. Jiang Fan encountered a major change in his life. He sold his property to pay off debts and turned from a wealthy son into a poverty-stricken "orphan". Even if Qin Jinglun, the head of the Qin family in Yanjing, was willing to help Jiang Fan, Jiang Fan would not accept any assistance from Qin Jinglun, who abandoned his wife and son.
As for Jiang Fan's younger sister Qin Ziling, Mo Qingwu had heard a little bit about it. The Qin family regarded Qin Ziling as their eldest daughter, but only well. Qin Ziling did not necessarily have the intention or strength to help her brother Jiang Fan, whom she had never met.
The annual tuition fee for the Chinese Pharmacy major is 5,500 yuan, and the accommodation fee is 800 yuan a year. No matter how frugal the living expenses are, the annual living expenses are at least 2,000 yuan. Expenses of more than 8,000 yuan a year are a huge expense for an ordinary family, let alone Jiang Fan, who is alone.
After encountering a major change in his life, he is now penniless. Perhaps there are other reasons. He has no money to continue his studies in college, and his life has lost its purpose and meaning. Jiang Fan just gave up on himself, gave up on himself, and drifted with the crowd.
Mo Qingwu took out a stack of hundred-dollar bills from her bag. Although the money was not much, it could solve Jiang Fan's urgent need. She could earn money part-time during the winter and summer vacations. With scholarships, grants and tuition exemptions, she could successfully complete her studies. She then handed it to Jiang Fan, "This is my lucky money, six points a year, and it will be paid back within three years after graduation."
Jiang Fan was speechless for a moment. This was not the same routine as Li Ziqian. Worried that his self-esteem would be damaged, he lent him money in the name of loan sharking to allow him to continue studying in college and complete his studies.
"What, too little?"
Mo Qingwu rolled her eyes secretly. Now, unlike before, she could no longer spend money as lavishly as before. She had no choice but to continue: "Take good exams at the end of the semester. Scholarships are not reliable. It's not a big problem to have bursaries and tuition fees waived. Spend some time while you're at it."
"Goddess Mo, thank you for your kindness. I'm not short of money now. Last month, someone even more shady than you lent me fifty thousand yuan at eight o'clock a year."
"Li Ziqian?"
"You know him?"
“Unfamiliar”
, Mo Qingwu nodded lightly. The little princess of the Li family had a good relationship with Qin Ziling. It was okay for Qin Ziling to borrow money from Jiang Fan through Li Ziqian. Then she complained: "You are no longer short of money, but you still don't do your job every day and don't study hard."
"Those who know others are wise, those who know themselves are wise; those who conquer others are powerful, those who conquer themselves are strong; those who are content are rich, and those who force themselves are ambitious."
Jiang Fan looked at Mo Qingwu speechlessly. He was doing his job properly so he spent his time and energy on cultivation instead of wasting it in class. "Goddess Mo, now that my IQ is high and I can never forget what I see, I no longer need to waste time in class."
With a high IQ and a photographic memory, Mo Qingwu pretended to be vomiting and pretended to be struck by lightning. By pretending like this, you will not be afraid of being struck by lightning again. He suddenly said: "The husband's etiquette, the loyalty is thin and the first is chaos."
"Tao Te Ching·Chapter 38: Those who know beforehand are the beginning of the magnificence of the Tao and its folly.
Therefore, a true man should live in the rich and not in the weak; he should live in the truth and not in the beautiful."
"You are truly worthy of it, and there is no one who can replace you."
"Volume 2 of the Tianliangshou Sutra: When people are in the world, they are born and die alone in the midst of love and desire. They go and come alone. They should go to the place of joy and suffering. They should do it by themselves. There is no one to replace them.
Good and evil change, and disasters and blessings occur in different places,,,"
Do you really have a photographic memory? Mo Qingwu looked at Jiang Fan in surprise. He answered Buddhist scriptures and Taoist scriptures fluently. He must have memorized the professional knowledge, and there was no need to give any more advice. He handed Jiang Fan a wad of banknotes, six points a year, and paid off within three years after graduation. He walked away depressed.
Well, Mo Qingwu, the class beauty, is quite good. I learned yesterday that he dropped out of school, so I specially prepared 10,000 yuan to lend him the money to meet his urgent needs and persuade him to finish college., don’t give up on yourself, find your way back, change your mind, and be a new person!
Collecting 10,000 yuan, he went back to the dormitory to get his household registration book, passport, driver's license, jade pendant and other things. He told everyone to rent a house outside and call them if anything happened. Then he rode a Yamaha motorcycle towards the Zixuan Villa halfway up the mountain.
Zixuan Villa is indeed one of the top villas in Jinling. The strict security measures are only a small part of it. The chirping of birds and insects during the day adds a bit of liveliness to the Villa, but at night the Villa is extremely quiet, like a paradise in the bustling city!
Sitting cross-legged on the rooftop of the villa, Jiang Fan was instantly immersed in a state of transcendence. The surging Yangtze River, the lush Purple Mountain, the sparkling Xuanwu Lake, and the thin spiritual energy swarmed towards the Zixuan Villa halfway up the mountain as if being summoned.
The rising sun rises in the east, and the purple air comes from the east.
Silks of purple energy entered Jiang Fan's body like the essence of heaven and earth. Before the first ray of morning light came, a loud and long 'wolf roar' broke the tranquility of Purple Mountain, causing Jiang Fan, who was immersed in cultivation, to wake up suddenly.
Jiang Fan opened his eyes slightly. The location of Zixuan Villa is unique in Jinling. It is backed by Purple Mountain and faces Xuanwu Lake. It is also a good place to watch the sunrise. The top of the mountain is the best sunrise viewing platform. It is understandable that Jiang Fan was awakened by the "wolf roar" of the citizens who were watching the sunrise on the rooftop of the villa.
It doesn't matter, I will practice on the lawn in the villa courtyard from now on, close my eyes and continue practicing. Not long after, I was disturbed again by the singing of some tourists who hated the rich. The singing was loud, as if they were afraid that the rich people of Zixuan Villa would sleep too peacefully.
It was really a great departure. He stopped and stood up. Jiang Fan walked towards the bedroom on the third floor of the villa. The body quenching liquid medicinal materials for training were ready, but the bathroom was empty. There were shampoo, shower gel, facial cleanser, toothpaste, toothbrush and other toiletries, but there were no towels, bath towels, bath towels and other things.,,
I have to say that rich people really cherish their lives. At 5:30 in the morning, except for night shift workers and high school students, most of the citizens are immersed in their dreams and want to go back to sleep after 7 o'clock. Some old people living in Zixuan Villa have already started morning exercises in the small park in the villa, whether they are Tai Chi or Ba Duan Jin. They are all in good shape.
Haha, Jiang Fan couldn't help but chuckle. If the people of Jiangsu lived in the world of cultivation, the spirit of King Juan alone would probably kill all the monks in the world of cultivation, sweep across the world of cultivation, and unify the vast universe!
Jiang Fan walked leisurely down the mountain with a wry smile on his face. Maybe he really needed to take in a boy, no, find a nanny to take care of his daily life and handle daily affairs without wasting time on such trivial matters.
Walking slowly to the Zhuxin Lake Park at the foot of the mountain, you will see the emerald green bamboo forest. The air is filled with the faint fragrance of bamboo. The breeze blows, the bamboo leaves rustle, the lake surface ripples, and you take a deep breath. It instantly makes you feel relaxed and happy, and your fatigue is swept away.
Just as Jiang Fan was immersed in the refreshing bamboo fragrance, the conversation of an old man and a young man came from the bamboo forest in front of him. It seemed that an old man was teaching his grandson Kung Fu and scolding his grandson for being arrogant, domineering, and arrogant.
Thunder punch? Jiang Fan couldn't help but feel confused. There were many fragments of the sect-defeating skills of the Leihe Sect, the eighth-level sect in the snowy region tens of thousands of years ago. Only monks with thunder-attribute spiritual roots could practice it. Could it be that the skills of Cangxuan Continent had also spread to the earth, and there were also monks on the earth?
